offering_description.value: Ironwood develops prescription medicines for people with gastrointestinal disorders. It co-markets a constipation treatment in the United States, licenses it to partners abroad, and develops investigational treatments for short bowel syndrome.

primary_products.value: Linaclotide for irritable bowel syndrome with constipation and chronic idiopathic constipation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmaceutical commercialization partners, wholesalers and pharmacies; B2C: Patients who obtain the medication through pharmacies

revenue_model.value: other: Share of US proceeds from linaclotide sales under the commercialization agreement; licensing or royalties: Licensing payments and royalties from overseas linaclotide commercialization partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops gastrointestinal drugs and relies on manufacturing and commercialization partners to supply prescription markets

geography_served.value: global: United States and licensed markets in Europe and Asia, including Japan and China

specialization.value: related lines: Prescription constipation treatment and investigational therapies for short bowel syndrome

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: US commercialization partner and overseas pharmaceutical licensees; third-party retail: Pharmacies dispensing linaclotide on prescription

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Prescription drugs require FDA and overseas marketing approvals and are subject to clinical trial and manufacturing rules.

notes: The current stage of the short bowel syndrome program and availability in individual overseas markets are uncertain.
